title.zh: 课程导论与电力系统概览

summary.en: Meet the course team, explore the knowledge roadmap, and learn the tools and power-system design workflow.
summary.zh: 认识课程团队、知识框架与学习工具，了解电力系统设计流程。

lab_focus.en: Explore the course workflow from system data to a design decision.
lab_focus.zh: 沿课程设计流程，连接系统数据、计算分析与设计决策。

L02.title_zh: 电力系统演进与符号表示

summary.en: Trace the physical power system, construct a one-line diagram, and reconcile real and reactive power.
summary.zh: 梳理电力系统的物理路径，建立单线图，核对有功与无功功率平衡。

lab_focus.en: Connect generators, buses, transformers, lines, loads, and shunts in a one-line diagram.
lab_focus.zh: 在单线图中连接发电机、母线、变压器、线路、负荷与并联元件。

L03.title_zh: 最优燃料组合分析 I

summary.en: Demand, energy, capacity factor, planning reserve margin, and load-duration curves.
summary.zh: 区分需求、能量与容量，学习容量因子、规划备用裕度和负荷持续曲线。

lab_focus.en: Reorder a chronological load profile and compare energy with its load-duration curve.
lab_focus.zh: 将时序负荷排序为负荷持续曲线，并比较两者的能量。

summary.en: Build screening curves, find cost crossovers, form net load, and check a generation portfolio.
summary.zh: 建立成本筛选曲线、求交点、计算净负荷，并检验发电组合。

lab_focus.en: Change fixed and variable costs, then inspect crossover hours and net-load coverage.
lab_focus.zh: 调整固定成本与变动成本，观察交叉运行小时和净负荷覆盖情况。

summary.en: Map sinusoidal waveforms to RMS phasors; convert and add polar and rectangular representations.
summary.zh: 在正弦波形与 RMS 相量之间转换，练习极坐标、直角坐标和相量加法。

lab_focus.en: Vary magnitude and phase while comparing the waveform, phasor, and rectangular components.
lab_focus.zh: 调整幅值与相位，同时比较时域波形、相量和直角坐标分量。

summary.en: Calculate real, reactive, complex, and apparent power with consistent load and generator signs.
summary.zh: 按统一的负荷与发电机符号约定，计算有功、无功、复功率和视在功率。

lab_focus.en: Change the voltage–current phase difference and follow the power triangle and power factor.
lab_focus.zh: 改变电压与电流的相位差，观察功率三角形和功率因数。

summary.en: Determine target reactive power, shunt compensation, and capacitance for power-factor correction.
summary.zh: 从目标功率因数计算目标无功、并联补偿容量与电容值。

lab_focus.en: Adjust the target power factor and compare compensation requirements with the original load.
lab_focus.zh: 调整目标功率因数，比较补偿需求与原始负荷。

summary.en: Balanced sets, phase sequence, symmetrical components, and wye/delta voltage and current relations.
summary.zh: 学习平衡三相相量、相序、对称分量，以及星形和三角形的电压电流关系。

lab_focus.en: Switch phase sequence and connection while inspecting phase and line phasors.
lab_focus.zh: 切换相序与接线方式，比较相电压、线电压及相电流、线电流。

summary.en: Use per-phase equivalents to calculate three-phase power and reconcile source, line, and load.
summary.zh: 利用每相等值电路计算三相功率，核对电源、线路与负荷的功率平衡。

lab_focus.en: Compare balanced wye and delta feeders, voltage drop, and power balance.
lab_focus.zh: 比较平衡星形与三角形馈线的电压降和功率平衡。

summary.en: Worked examples on phase sequence, wye/delta conversion, branch currents, and feeder power balance.
summary.zh: 通过例题练习相序、星形与三角形变换、支路电流及馈线功率平衡。

lab_focus.en: Step through connection and power examples with explicit reference directions.
lab_focus.zh: 按明确的参考方向，逐步完成接线关系与功率计算例题。

summary.en: Derive ideal voltage and current ratios, power conservation, and impedance referral.
summary.zh: 推导理想变压器的电压、电流比，功率守恒和阻抗折算关系。

lab_focus.en: Change the turns ratio and compare physical quantities and referred impedance on both sides.
lab_focus.zh: 调整匝数比，比较两侧物理量与折算后的阻抗。

summary.en: Add winding resistance, leakage reactance, excitation, and checked equivalent-circuit approximations.
summary.zh: 引入绕组电阻、漏抗和励磁支路，检验等值电路的近似。

lab_focus.en: Compare exact, input-shunt, and series transformer approximations at an operating point.
lab_focus.zh: 在同一运行点比较精确电路、输入并联励磁近似和串联近似。

summary.en: Infer transformer parameters from open- and short-circuit tests; calculate regulation and efficiency.
summary.zh: 从开路与短路试验确定模型参数，计算电压调整率和效率。

lab_focus.en: Enter test readings and inspect the inferred parameters, regulation, and loss balance.
lab_focus.zh: 输入试验读数，检验推算参数、电压调整率与损耗平衡。

summary.en: Choose coherent bases and normalize voltage, current, impedance, admittance, and power.
summary.zh: 选择相容的基准值，对电压、电流、阻抗、导纳和功率进行标幺化。

lab_focus.en: Change independent bases and recover the same physical circuit from per-unit quantities.
lab_focus.zh: 调整独立基准值，从标幺量还原同一个物理电路。

summary.en: Propagate bases through transformers and apply change of base across a multi-voltage network.
summary.zh: 通过变压器传递基准值，在多电压等级网络中应用基准变换。

lab_focus.en: Track corresponding voltage bases through a transformer and verify impedance invariance.
lab_focus.zh: 跟踪变压器两侧对应电压基准，检验物理阻抗的一致性。

summary.en: Complete single-phase transformer and three-phase wye/delta normalization examples.
summary.zh: 完成单相变压器及三相星形、三角形电路的标幺化例题。

lab_focus.en: Normalize complete transformer networks and recover the correct line and phase quantities.
lab_focus.zh: 对完整变压器网络进行标幺化，恢复正确的线量和相量。

summary.en: Separate material area, temperature and return geometry, then recover one-conductor and loop impedance.
summary.zh: 区分材料面积、温度和回流几何，计算单根导线与整个回路的阻抗。

lab_focus.en: Conductor resistance and flux linkage
lab_focus.zh: 导线电阻与磁通链

summary.en: Compute actual mutual distances and the geometric mean, then reproduce the transposed per-phase inductance.
summary.zh: 计算实际互距和几何平均距离，复现换位线路的每相电感。

lab_focus.en: Three-phase GMD, GMR and transposition
lab_focus.zh: 三相 GMD、GMR 与换位

summary.en: Use physical radius to find capacitance, split a nominal π shunt and check phase current against three-phase reactive supply.
summary.zh: 用实际半径计算电容，拆分标称 π 的并联电纳，并核对相电流与三相无功供给。

lab_focus.en: Capacitance and charging power
lab_focus.zh: 电容与充电功率

summary.en: Model one to four symmetric subconductors, distinguish magnetic/electric self radii and build the circuit branch on a stated system base.
summary.zh: 模拟每相一至四根对称子导线，区分磁、电自半径，并按给定系统基准建立线路支路。

lab_focus.en: Bundles, physical circuits and per-unit branches
lab_focus.zh: 分裂导线、物理回路与标幺支路

summary.en: Construct the short-line model with declared terminal-current reference directions.
summary.zh: 在明确的端口电流参考方向下建立短线路模型。

lab_focus.en: Vary the short line's series impedance and receiving-end load to inspect terminal quantities.
lab_focus.zh: 调整短线路串联阻抗与受端负荷，观察端口量。

summary.en: Build the nominal-π circuit from series impedance and split shunt admittance.
summary.zh: 利用串联阻抗与两端分配的并联导纳建立标称 π 型电路。

lab_focus.en: Compare nominal-π terminal results as line charging and load change.
lab_focus.zh: 改变线路充电与负荷，比较标称 π 模型的端口结果。

summary.en: Derive distributed long-line equations, propagation constants, and terminal relationships.
summary.zh: 推导长线路分布参数方程、传播常数和端口关系。

lab_focus.en: Explore line length and loading while comparing distributed and lumped models.
lab_focus.zh: 调整线路长度与负载，比较分布参数和集中参数模型。

summary.en: Identify power-flow inputs, bus types, unknowns, net injections, topology, and operating limits.
summary.zh: 识别潮流输入、节点类型、未知量、净注入、拓扑与运行限值。

lab_focus.en: Classify buses and inspect the known quantities, unknowns, and net injections of a network.
lab_focus.zh: 分类网络节点，检查各节点的已知量、未知量和净注入。

summary.en: Assemble Y-bus from series branches, line charging, fixed shunts, and transformer taps.
summary.zh: 由串联支路、线路充电、固定并联元件和变压器分接头组装节点导纳矩阵。

lab_focus.en: Build branch stamps and inspect how charging, taps, and outages change Y-bus.
lab_focus.zh: 建立支路矩阵，观察充电、分接头与支路断开如何改变节点导纳矩阵。

summary.en: Form polar power equations, choose the state, calculate mismatches, and apply a stopping tolerance.
summary.zh: 建立极坐标功率方程，确定状态量，计算不平衡量并应用收敛容差。

lab_focus.en: Change a trial voltage state and inspect real/reactive mismatches and the residual norm.
lab_focus.zh: 改变试算电压状态，观察有功与无功不平衡量及残差范数。

summary.en: Run Gauss–Seidel PQ and PV updates, restore PV magnitude, and check reactive-power capability.
summary.zh: 执行高斯—赛德尔 PQ、PV 更新，恢复 PV 电压幅值并检查无功能力。

lab_focus.en: Step through an ordered sweep and compare voltage updates, residuals, and PV reactive limits.
lab_focus.zh: 逐步执行有序迭代，比较电压更新、残差和 PV 无功限值。

summary.en: Use Newton's Jacobian and corrections, then validate convergence, branch flows, and operating limits.
summary.zh: 利用牛顿法雅可比矩阵与修正量，检验收敛、支路潮流和运行限值。

lab_focus.en: Inspect Newton corrections and distinguish a converged solution from an acceptable operating point.
lab_focus.zh: 观察牛顿修正量，区分求解收敛与运行点满足限值。

summary.en: Build three-phase banks and distinguish winding, line, and bank relationships.
summary.zh: 建立三相变压器组，区分绕组量、线量与变压器组关系。

lab_focus.en: Switch bank connections and inspect winding versus line ratios.
lab_focus.zh: 切换变压器组接线，比较绕组比与线量比。

summary.en: Derive a balanced Y–Δ branch from actual terminal quantities and system bases; distinguish bank, autotransformer and tap ratios.
summary.zh: 以实际端口量与系统基准推导平衡 Y–Δ 支路，区分变压器组、自耦与分接变比。

lab_focus.en: Check base cancellation, physical impedance and connection displacement, then explore tap changes.
lab_focus.zh: 检查基准约消、实际阻抗与接线相移，再探索分接变化。
